notice: This file reports repository evidence and review state only. It is not legal advice, a citator, or a representation that GH Real Estate is legally compliant.

currentness.promotion_rule: A detected or discovered change remains a candidate until qualified legal review approves a complete dated release through a pull request.

consumer_policy.general_research: Use the approved release with its visible current-through date and verify live official authority for material reliance.
consumer_policy.production_systems: Pin an approved release commit or tag; never consume an unreviewed discovery result or candidate branch.
consumer_policy.degraded_state: If an applicable source is unavailable, changed, overdue, or awaiting review, preserve the approved baseline and require live official verification before high-risk action.

known_limitations: Monitoring known URLs cannot discover every new statute, ordinance, regulation, notice, replacement URL, later case, or new source family.
Five approved records are availability-only comparisons: one FTC page, one normalized HUD memorandum, and three Kansas case extracts.
Availability-only success proves expected reachability and payload type, not substantive equality or currentness.
Version-specific official URLs can verify the collected edition but cannot prove that a newer edition, notice, guidance document, or later history does not exist.
The municipal semantic PDF comparison may not detect a vector-only or annotation-only change that leaves extracted text, page geometry, and embedded graphics unchanged.
Two KHRC sources use plain HTTP, so matching bytes do not independently prove freshness against replay.
Case-law coverage is curated rather than exhaustive and is not a complete citator.
Copyrighted model building and safety codes incorporated by reference are not reproduced in full.
Applicability depends on property, financing, federal-program, ownership, lease, transaction, and enforcement facts that automation cannot establish.
